2608.25999.title: Distinct dynamics of conceptual and referential disruptions in human reading and large language model processing
2608.25999.paper_summary: Linguistic meaning is grounded in conceptual content, from which reference to particular entities emerges as words enter discourse. To examine the processing dynamics associated with these two dimensions of meaning, we selectively disrupted conceptual or referential information in short narratives and traced the resulting effects in human self-paced reading and in the predictive and representational processing of large language models. In human reading, conceptual disruptions produced a strong but localized processing cost, emerging immediately after the distorted word, reaching an early maximum, and then declining rapidly. Referential disruptions produced weaker effects, which decreased more gradually across subsequent words, and were more strongly modulated by sentence boundaries. In the language model, both disruptions emerged immediately at the manipulated word. Contextual model surprisal showed a pattern closely paralleling human reading: conceptual disruption produced a larger, more locally concentrated effect that decayed rapidly, whereas referential disruption produced a smaller and more gradual downstream effect. Output-layer representations showed a different pattern: referential disruption produced a larger initial displacement, while both distortions were subsequently characterized by power-law decay. Together, these results provide convergent evidence for distinguishable processing dynamics of two types of meaning: conceptual information imposes a more locally concentrated integration cost, whereas referential information engages a more distributed process of maintaining discourse-level identity.
2608.25999.paper_summary_zh: 語言意義根植於概念內容，從中參考特定實體隨著詞語進入話語而產生。為了檢視與這兩個意義維度相關的處理動態，我們在短篇敘事中選擇性地干擾了概念或參照資訊，並追蹤了這些變化對人類自我調節閱讀以及大型語言模型的預測和表徵處理的影響。在人類閱讀中，概念干擾產生了強烈但局部的處理成本，這種成本在扭曲的詞語之後立即出現，達到早期的最大值，然後迅速下降。參照干擾產生了較弱的效果，這些效果在隨後的詞語中逐漸減少，並且受到句子邊界的更強調制。在語言模型中，這兩種干擾在被操控的詞語上立即出現。上下文模型的驚訝度顯示出與人類閱讀密切平行的模式：概念干擾產生了更大且更局部集中的效果，迅速衰減，而參照干擾則產生了較小且更逐漸的下游效果。輸出層的表徵顯示出不同的模式：參照干擾產生了更大的初始位移，而這兩種扭曲隨後都以冪律衰減為特徵。總體而言，這些結果提供了可區分的兩種類型意義的處理動態的收斂證據：概念資訊施加了更局部集中的整合成本，而參照資訊則涉及維持話語層次身份的更分散過程。
